hook_text: Minus 15%, then plus 15%. Back where you started... right? WRONG.
clip_script: Before celebrating, stand on the classic error until it cannot bite you. Many learners take 15 percent of the original R800 for both steps: minus R120, plus R120 — and announce a final price of R800, because the fifteens cancel. They do not cancel. The discount acted on R800, but the VAT acted on the smaller R680 — so the VAT put back only R102 where the discount removed R120. Equal rates on unequal bases are unequal amounts of money. Down then up at the same rate always strands you slightly below the start, because the increase works on a smaller base.
visual_style: Price tag animation: R800 shrinking with a red -15% stamp, then growing with a green +15% stamp but visibly failing to reach the original height, gap highlighted.
pacing: Confident setup of the trap, dramatic reveal, brisk explanation.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to master multipliers and never fall for it again.
